announcements.title: Welcome to Announcements
announcements.body: Watchio now has a dedicated inbox for feature news, maintenance notices, and important alerts.

announcements.title: TV Performance Improvements
announcements.body: Movies and Series now load progressively for faster browsing on Android TV and Fire TV devices.

announcements.title: Live TV Update 📺
announcements.body: A new Watchio update is now available! Live TV has been improved with NOW, NEXT and LATER programme information, making it easier to see what's currently playing and what's coming up without opening the full TV Guide. We've also improved programme matching, performance and the Live TV layout. Update Watchio to the latest version to get the new features.
